cases.question: When should I use concorde-context instead of feature-select?
cases.expected: Distinguish read-only bounded context from changing active feature selection.

cases.question: In this project, where should the implementation checklist for the selected feature live?
cases.expected: Use installed routing guidance and only the selected feature's relevant sources.

cases.question: When should I use a sub-feature instead of a feature refinement?
cases.expected: Distinguish one-module two-level containment from adjacent-module architectural refinement.

cases.question: What parent and sibling sources may I read while implementing the selected sub-feature?
cases.expected: Read parent durable spec/design as aggregate context, use sibling summaries only, and exclude parent or sibling attempts.

cases.question: How should I change the module?
cases.expected: Ask one focused clarification about the module, feature, or intended behavior.

cases.question: Which Concorde commands are installed when the manifest and project documentation disagree?
cases.expected: Expose the disagreement and source versions without silently choosing agreement.

cases.question: Write a database migration for my application.
cases.expected: State that general implementation work is outside the question surface and do not execute it.
